claims.claim: Current delete path marks tombstones/live state and does not immediately rewrite the main disk index.
Deleting 60% of vectors has mean latency <0.9 ms/vector under the CPU cap.
Materializing marked deletes through merge has measured wall time under CPU_CAP=16.
After repeated 60% delete + equal-count insert cycles, retuned route/L can reach recall@10 >= 98%.
PQ drift from zero-data insertion is quantified against direct-build PQ code, including retrain cost.
The v2 main disk index stores only raw vectors plus adjacency; labels live in sidecar files.
